name: Three courses in one cohort packet
text:
First-Year Science Cohort — Fall 2026 Course Packet
Keep this page: it lists every graded deadline for your three cohort courses.

BIO 150 Principles of Biology · MWF 10:00 AM · Life Sciences 120
Instructor: Dr. Ramos
Lab reports are due at the start of your lab section.
- Lab Report 1 (microscopy) due September 11
- Quiz 1 on September 18
- Lab Report 2 (enzymes) due October 2
- Midterm Exam on October 16
- Lab Report 3 (genetics) due November 6
- Final Exam on December 11, 10:30 AM

CHEM 101 General Chemistry I · TR 8:00 AM · Chemistry 200
Instructor: Prof. Nguyen
Weekly online problem sets close Mondays at 9:00 AM.
- Exam 1: September 24
- Exam 2: October 22
- Exam 3: November 19
- Lab notebook check due December 3
- Final Exam: December 14, 8:00 AM

HIST 110 World Civilizations · TR 1:00 PM · Humanities 301
Instructor: Dr. Castillo
- Map quiz on September 10
- Primary source analysis due October 1
- Midterm essay due October 29
- Museum visit reflection due November 12
- Final paper due December 8

Cohort events
- Study skills workshop: September 2, 6:00 PM (optional)
- Advising week: October 19-23, no assignments due
- Thanksgiving recess: November 25-29
notes: The optional workshop is not graded and is excluded.
